notes: Postscript exposes official ReadMe Markdown pages through llms.txt; each reference page includes an embedded OpenAPI definition.
The compact local spec combines the six current v2 reference endpoints listed in llms.txt: subscribers list/get/update, custom events, unsubscribe, and redact.
Partner shop-token support is modeled as the documented X-Postscript-Shop-Token header flag; the primary credential is POSTSCRIPT_API_KEY.
Live vendor behavior was not verified because no Postscript credentials were available.

novel_features.name: Subscriber Directory
novel_features.description: List Postscript subscribers with documented email, phone, Shopify customer, ps_id, date, page, and sort filters.

novel_features.name: Subscriber Lookup
novel_features.description: Retrieve an individual Postscript subscriber by ID, including contact fields, tags, custom properties, and subscription sendability state.

novel_features.name: Custom Event Intake
novel_features.description: Send documented Postscript custom events with subscriber identifiers, occurrence timestamps, external IDs, and event properties for flows.
